label.explanation: payment-svc reloaded CARDPROC_API_KEY at version 23 and the previous version was revoked (line 193); the new value is not one the card processor accepts, so every call gets 401 Unauthorized (lines 204, 211, 218, 227). A 401 is the provider answering correctly, not an outage. order-service's 502s (lines 210, 215, 234, 239, 249, 257) and api-gateway's (lines 203, 212, 214, 221, 230, 235, 238, 243, 247, 251, 256, 262) are symptoms. Red herrings: line 207 (a one-off slow reporting query on audit_log, not on the failing request path); lines 75, 77 (a single card processor connection reset that succeeded on retry, minutes before onset); lines 174, 183 (a deploy of order-consumer, which is not on the failing request path and kept processing normally).
